speech.heard: Qatar has 99.2% wage and salaried workers. In Chad, it is 8.4%. Qatar is the world's highest. Almost every worker there has a formal employment contract. Chad is the world's lowest. Most work for themselves without a steady, basic pay. Side by side, Qatar has 12 times the share of paid employees in Chad. These workers hold contracts for a basic pay that does not depend on business revenue. Brazil has 69.7%, China has 62.3%, Nigeria has 13.8%, Madagascar has 11.7%, and Niger 10.5%. Do you have a formal employment contract?
